name: USD/CAD Triple SMA Crossover - 3 Lot Sizing
description: Multi-timeframe moving average crossover strategy on USD/CAD using 20/50/200-day SMAs on 1H timeframe. Long when 20 crosses above 50 or 200, short when crossing below. Position sizing: 3 standard lots (300,000 units) for 20×50 crosses, 6 standard lots (600,000 units) for 20×200 crosses.
source:
# Data source - 1H timeframe
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Moving Averages (converted to hourly periods)
# 20-day = 480 hours, 50-day = 1200 hours, 200-day = 4800 hours
sma_20 = ma(period=480, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=1200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=4800, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Crossover signals for 20×50
cross_20_above_50 = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
cross_20_below_50 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# Crossover signals for 20×200
cross_20_above_200 = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
cross_20_below_200 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# Aggregate entry signals
long_entry = cross_20_above_50 or cross_20_above_200
short_entry = cross_20_below_50 or cross_20_below_200

# Determine size based on which crossover (200 takes priority for larger size)
is_200_cross = cross_20_above_200 or cross_20_below_200
is_50_cross = cross_20_above_50 or cross_20_below_50

# Size: 600,000 for 200-cross, 300,000 for 50-cross
size_units = 600000 if is_200_cross else (300000 if is_50_cross else 0)

# Entry/Exit zones - each crossover closes previous and opens new
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing with unit type (notional units)
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=size_units)

# Visualization - SMAs
timeseries_lines(
    title="Triple SMA",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 20-day", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 50-day", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 200-day", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200)
